title: A library catalogue
description:
Model books in a library with a dataclass and an enum.

```
> lend dune Ada
Dune is now on loan to Ada
> lend dune Bob
Dune is already on loan to Ada
> return dune
Dune is back
> list
Dune (Herbert) - available
Emma (Austen) - available
```
